title: Figure 18. Proposed Near-Earth Distribution of Frequency Time Standard (HFGW stations)
description: Wireframe globe with four transmitter symbols surrounded by concentric radiating circles at coordinates (60,-150), (60,120), (-30,-60) and (-30,30), with arrows from the label "Large HFGW Transmitter Ground Stations". Caption: "Figure 18. A Proposed Near-Earth Distribution of Frequency Time Standard". Text describes synchronized ground stations, remote terminals and TDOA-based positioning.
